0.original: Hancock seems to be quite pleased with himself.

48.original: So that building's filled with Garleans...

49.original: Some might deem it unwise to loiter outside the gates of the consulate of a hostile empire.

51.original: Compared to the Hingan architecture, this is drab and uninspired. Or perhaps I've had my fill of Garlean aesthetics, such as they are.

52.original: There is oh so much more I could speak of─the soothing waters of the onsen, the ephemeral delights of the pleasure district─but you are doubtless still weary from your long sea voyage.

53.original: Let us retire to the company offices.

54.original: Even though this feels just as out of place as the Garlean Consulate, it's a lot more...comforting.

55.original: ...There is no denying that this place was built for an Ul'dahn.

56.original: Ahhh, the unmistakable scent of wealth and power...

57.original: (I daresay we could travel to Meracydia or the New World and find a man like Hancock waiting for us.)

58.original: Greetings, sirs and ladies, and welcome to the Kugane branch offices of the East Aldenard Trading Company.

59.original: At long last, we arrive at our destination. May I present to you our humble offices.

60.original: We have much to discuss, so I will refrain from further prattle. Come, come, right this way!

61.original: I'm not sure how I imagined our time in the Far East unfolding, but it definitely didn't involve Ul'dahns. And especially not <hex:021A020203>these<hex:021A020103> Ul'dahns. Still...whatever works, right?

62.original: He was not exaggerating when he spoke of their wards' efficacy. Whoever wove them did so with consummate skill...

63.original: Oh, this place takes me back! It reminds me of the workshop of an Ul'dahn lapidary I once served!

64.original: I must confess, I am an avid collector of all things Far Eastern. See for yourself. I insist!

65.original: Though I am reluctant to take any action whatsoever that could be construed as placing ourselves in Lord Lolorito's debt...we must avail ourselves of what means are available.

66.original: Our Ala Mhigan allies placed their faith in us, and I do not intend to disappoint them...

67.original: The Scions are always welcome here. Shall I show you inside?
